title: Bob Brier's examination suggests Tutankhamun died from a blow to the back of the head

tellings.quote: So, um, Dr. [clears throat] Bob Brier did uh did an investigation on him maybe back in the 90s and examined his body and the way that the pool the way that the blood pulls in the back of his skull looks like he was hit in the back of the head.

plain: In the 1990s, the Egyptologist Bob Brier examined the body of Tutankhamun and found that the way blood had pooled at the back of the skull looked like the young pharaoh had been hit on the back of the head. A researcher who goes by Luke Caverns passes this on to Michels from Brier's work. If true, it would mean Tutankhamun was killed.
